data: Which of the following factors is investigated in this figure?

The figure shows the proportion of balanced triangles with different proportions of positive edges in traditional balance theory. The x-axis represents the proportion of positive edges, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The y-axis represents the proportion of balanced trisadic closures, also ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. There are five lines in the graph, each representing a different factor: Random Baseline, Frequency, Length, Quality, and Sentiment Polarity. The lines are color-coded for easy identification. The caption provides context about the investigation of these factors in the figure. Therefore, the factors investigated in this figure are Random Baseline, Frequency, Length, Quality, and Sentiment Polarity.
